title: MATH 221 or MATH 220 (Calculus I)
description: A first calculus course: limits, derivatives and their applications, and an introduction to integrals. Some universities offer a faster version for students who saw calculus in high school and a longer one for students who did not.
notes: Choice slot: UIUC's MATH 221 (some calculus background) or MATH 220 (no calculus background). Official descriptions are in data/raw/uiuc/ (courses-math page).

title: CS 210 or CS 211 (Ethical & Professional Issues)
description: A short course on ethics and professional conduct in computing, covering topics such as privacy, intellectual property, security, and professional responsibility.
notes: Choice slot: UIUC's CS 210 (2 hours) or CS 211 (3 hours). Official descriptions are in data/raw/uiuc/ (courses-cs page).

title: Science Elective
description: A natural science course chosen from an approved list, such as chemistry, biology, astronomy, or geology, in addition to the program's required physics.
notes: UIUC: one course from the Natural Science & Technology list.

title: Composition I
description: A first-year writing course on academic reading, argument, research, and revision. Students write for different audiences and purposes.
notes: UIUC: Composition I (4-6 hours), taken in the first or second semester.

title: General Education course (Humanities or Social/Behavioral Science)
description: A general education course in the humanities, arts, or social and behavioral sciences, chosen from an approved list. These courses add breadth outside engineering and computing.
notes: UIUC: Humanities & the Arts (6 hours) and Social & Behavioral Sciences (6 hours).

title: General Education course (Humanities or Social/Behavioral Science, Cultural Studies)
description: A general education course in the humanities or social and behavioral sciences that also meets a cultural studies requirement, such as non-Western, US minority, or Western and comparative cultures.
notes: UIUC: one course in each of three Cultural Studies categories.

title: Language Other Than English (3rd level)
description: A third-semester course in a language other than English, or the equivalent proficiency. Students with enough high school study or a placement result may already meet the requirement.
notes: UIUC: 0-15 hours depending on prior study.

title: Free Elective
description: Any course the student chooses, inside or outside the major, that counts toward the degree. Students often use free electives for a minor, extra courses in the major, or personal interests.
notes: UIUC: subject to the Grainger College of Engineering's restrictions on free electives, to reach 128 hours.

title: CS Technical Elective
description: An advanced computer science course chosen by the student from an approved list. Common options cover areas such as machine learning, security, graphics, networking, databases, and software engineering.
notes: UIUC: six courses (18 hours) from CS 397 and the CS 400-level courses, with breadth across focus areas.

title: CS Advanced Elective
description: An additional advanced course chosen by the student, usually in computer science or a closely related technical field, beyond the required technical electives.
notes: UIUC: two courses (6 hours) for a letter grade.
